$comment: Q246: build errors explained in plain words. Each rule maps what a failed build printed to an explanation id; the texts are buildError.<id>.what / .plain / .fix in config/ui-strings (en, tr). kind javac: `match` is a regex on the compiler's message of one error; kind gradle: on the text of Gradle's 'What went wrong' block. Rules are tried in order, the first match wins. params: name -> regex on the message plus its detail lines, group 1 is the value the strings can use as {name}. A build error no rule matches keeps showing its raw lines only. Not tied to a project: the rules only look at the compiler's and Gradle's own wording.
